doc.title: Cascadu interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019

title: Dual life as marine biologist and musician in Trinidad
summary: In Trinidad he worked as a full-time research biologist while playing music.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: So in Trinidad you were holding down a day gig?

I was doing as much as a marine research biologist as I was doing as a musician. My life was completely split between music and a full time research appointed job for which I got United Nations fellowships to travel and study. My specialty was in sea floor ecology.
